text:
Anna W: Meridian Edge just signed final entitlements for the 'southcape' region. Need greenlight for marketplace SKU + bare-metal fallback plan. Pinged legal and infra.

Raj P: Nice. What's the initial committed capacity? And any special KMS/HSM requirements?

Anna W: Committed 1000 vGPU-hours/mo initially. Partner requests HSM-only key wrap for model weights (customer-managed).

Marta S: OK. Legal: we can do HSM with addendum. Need partner-signed DPA + SOC attestation. I'll loop in legal.

Leo T: Infra: capacity can map to 2 dedicated nodepools (frg-southcape-1a/b). Need quota request to cloud vendor. Anyone have partner contact for quota form?

Anna W: Partner ops: @Jia L has the contact — Jia?

Jia L: I've got the vendor contacts. Will file quota request today. Quick question: does the SKU need a GPU family pin? Partner prefers A100 but can accept H100 fallback.

Raj P: Prefer H100 for perf, but plan acceptance: default to A100, fallback to H100? hmm reverse. Wait.

Leo T: We should set routing policy: H100 for low-latency tier, A100 for bulk; autoscale across both. Also add fallback to CPU-thin for emergencies.

Anna W: Decision: primary H100, fallback A100, then CPU layer. I'll update the rollout doc. Also we need marketplace listing approvals — steps?

Marta S: Marketplace listing: we need entitlement doc, product tile screenshots, pricing tier, and legal checklist. I'll own the listing packet.

partner-ops-bot: Quota request submitted: case #SR-84321. ETA 3–5 business days.

sre-bot: FYI: rolling deploy window next Thu 02:00–06:00 UTC. Slack alert will be posted.

Leo T: Can we get a canary with 5% traffic to Meridian Edge for 48h? Also add healthchecks: p95 latency <120ms.

Jia L: Partner agreed to canary and will provide test keys. Sending keys via secure channel.

Anna W: Action items: Legal (Marta) DPA addendum; Infra (Leo) quota tracking + nodepool config; Ops (Jia) submit quota, get keys; Product (Anna) marketplace packet. I'll schedule partner kickoff with Meridian next Mon 10:00 UTC.

Raj P: :thumbsup: Add me for performance SLO review.

Marta S: Looped legal: @legal-team please review DPA addendum draft (attached).

Anna W: Uploading rollout stub: ```terraform
module "southcape_nodes" {count = 2}
```

partner-ops-bot: Vendor responded: need region justification + expected throughput. Please provide #SR-84321 update.

Jia L: Uploading throughput numbers: 1000 vGPU-hours -> avg 15 req/s sustained. Posting in ticket now.

Anna W: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread after vendor reply.
